name: Augustine of Hippo
role: Bishop of Hippo and Christian theologian (354-430)
summary: Augustine held that earthly states are needed to keep a fallen world in peace but are just only insofar as they serve justice, and that all power comes from God. He defended the use of imperial law to compel Donatists and suppress idolatry, accepted slavery and the subordination of wife to husband as consequences of sin, and allowed just war as a sad necessity while condemning conquest for its own sake.
